description: "Use when editing docs, phase status, operations, security, deployment, or architecture records."
applyTo: "{docs/**,README.md,gpt.md}"

# Documentation and status

When architecture, security, deployment, configuration, or operations behavior changes:

- Update the relevant existing guide/runbook and applicable phase/status record.
- Record actual test commands/results, environment changes, migrations, and risks.
- Distinguish verified behavior from plans. Do not mark an exception resolved without evidence.
- Do not mark a phase complete merely because planned code was written.
- Prefer updating relevant files under `docs/` over creating parallel documentation.
